input.input_authority: A39/A01/A40 saved-family constants frozen in issue #531; the sixteen-stage profile is the corrected-track issue scenario, not a recovered historical T16 generator
input.input_semantics: Each finite source decimal/fraction is first parsed as binary64, then interpreted as that exact dyadic; A entries and acceptance edges that are exact terminating rationals remain exact.

optimal_family.coverage_argument: Every feasible history in the exact terminal fiber has the certified optimum value. Conversely, strict convexity in terminal state forces every optimal history into this fiber. The H rows and affine lift therefore encode the full joint optimizer relation without materializing an 84-dimensional H matrix.
optimal_family.joint_coordinate_order: x0,x1,...,x16,u0,u1,...,u15 (state vectors are coordinate-major within each stage)
query_contract: exact control-vector membership in the terminal fiber
exact 84-coordinate history reconstruction from a control vector
other geometric projections are unsupported unless separately computed with exact arithmetic
optimal_family.representation: bounded 16-control H-polytope with an exact affine lift to the 84 state/control coordinates

optimality.feasible_control_polytope: all registered control and phase inequalities are checked exactly
optimality.global_optimality_argument: The control polytope is convex; exact feasibility and zero gradient with zero multipliers satisfy convex quadratic KKT, proving the global minimum. Strict convexity in the terminal state makes the optimal terminal state unique.
optimality.numerical_optimizer: not invoked for this profile; the archived preliminary candidate is only a feasible starting point
optimality.solver_status: exact rational two-variable stationarity correction completed; independent exact KKT verification passed
optimality.strict_convexity: positive definite in terminal state: the first four criterion features recover x1..x4 with positive exact weights
